title: Doorbell and Package-Delivery Tracker
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections.
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=doorbell:event event=motion OR event=ring OR event=package
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(eval(event="package")) as deliveries, sum(eval(event="ring")) as rings by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts doorbell rings and detected package deliveries per day so you have a tidy record of who came by and what arrived.
value: A delivery log settles the 'did it actually arrive?' question and, with rings, shows patterns like a regular caller or missed visitors.
implementation: Forward doorbell events; schedule daily and review the delivery and visitor log.
visualization: Column chart of daily deliveries and rings.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps a daily tally of doorbell rings and deliveries, so you know what arrived and who stopped by.
